word-football.def: a game where two teams try to kick a round ball into a goal

word-basketball.def: a game where players throw a ball through a high hoop

word-volleyball.def: a game where two teams hit a ball over a high net with their hands

word-tennis.def: a game where two players or pairs hit a ball over a net with rackets

word-table-tennis.def: a game on a table where players hit a light ball with small paddles

word-handball.def: a team game where players throw a small ball into the other team's goal

word-ice-hockey.def: a fast team game where players on skates hit a small disk into a goal

word-golf.def: a game where you hit a small ball into holes using long clubs

word-boxing.def: a sport where two people fight by hitting each other with padded gloves

word-wrestling.def: a sport where two people try to throw each other to the ground

word-martial-arts.def: fighting sports from Asia, such as karate and judo, used for defense and exercise

word-athletics.def: sports such as running, jumping and throwing events

word-marathon.def: a very long running race of about 26 miles

word-cycling.def: the sport or activity of riding a bike

word-skiing.def: the sport of sliding down snowy slopes on long narrow boards fixed to your boots

word-snowboarding.def: the sport of sliding down snowy hills standing sideways on a single wide plank

word-ice-skating.def: moving over a frozen surface on shoes with metal blades

word-surfing.def: the sport of riding ocean waves while standing on a long narrow board

word-sailing.def: the sport of traveling on water in a boat pushed by the wind

word-rowing.def: moving a boat across water by pulling long oars

word-yoga.def: gentle exercise with slow stretches, poses and controlled breathing

word-fitness.def: the state of being strong and healthy, or the exercise done to get there

word-gymnastics.def: a sport of exercises on the floor and on equipment such as bars and beams

word-referee.def: the person in a game who makes sure the players follow the rules

word-championship.def: a contest held to decide who is the best player or team

word-tournament.def: a competition made up of many games, where players or teams are knocked out or ranked

word-league.def: a group of teams that play against each other during a season

word-olympics.def: a huge sports event held every four years with athletes from many countries

word-medal.def: a small metal disk given as a prize for winning or achieving something

word-point-score.def: a unit used to count how well you are doing in a game

word-draw-tie.def: the result of a game when both sides have the same score

word-half-time.def: the short break in the middle of a game

word-penalty-kick.def: a free shot at the goal from a short distance, given after a serious foul

word-foul.def: an action that breaks the rules of a game

word-pass-ball.def: to send the ball to a teammate

word-net-sports.def: a mesh of cords that stops the ball, divides the players or forms a goal

word-racket.def: a tool with a handle and a round frame of strings, used to hit a ball

word-sports-field.def: a large flat area marked out for team games

word-sports-court.def: a flat marked area where games like tennis and basketball are held

word-running-track.def: an oval path where athletes race

word-warm-up.def: to do light exercise to prepare your body before sports

word-stretch.def: to pull your arms, legs or muscles out to their full length

word-fit-healthy.def: strong and healthy because you exercise

word-athlete.def: a person who trains and competes in sports

word-champion.def: the person or team that wins a major competition

word-record-sport.def: the best result ever reached in a sport

word-opponent.def: the person or team you compete against

word-victory.def: the act of winning a game, battle or contest

word-defeat.def: the fact of losing a game or contest

word-beat-opponent.def: to win against someone in a game

word-cheer-team.def: to shout loudly to show support for a team

word-swimming.def: moving through water by using your arms and legs

word-running.def: moving fast on foot as exercise or sport

word-ski.def: to slide over snow on long narrow boards fixed to your boots

word-skate.def: to move over ice or smooth ground on shoes with blades or wheels
